Multi-turn conversation with system, user, assistant, and follow-up user messages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful assistant.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"What is 2 + 2?\",\"role\":\"user\"},{\"content\":\"2 + 2 equals 4.\",\"role\":\"assistant\"},{\"content\":\"And what is 4 + 4?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)

asyncio.run(main())
```
